visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair in a bun, wearing a dark olive green tank top and light grey pants, is in a brightly lit dance studio. She squats deeply, tucking her head between her knees and clasping her hands behind her ankles. Mirrors cover the back wall, reflecting her and the studio. (2) The same woman stands up and performs a shoulder stretch by interlacing her fingers behind her back and pushing her chest forward. She then transitions into a forward fold, attempting to reach the floor. (3) The scene cuts to a second woman with a bun, wearing a light blue one-shoulder top and black leggings. She is in a white photography studio with a black backdrop and studio lights. She mimics the crouching pose from the first phase, successfully wrapping her arms around her legs. (4) She stands up, performs the same backward hand stretch, and then executes a deep forward fold, grabbing her ankles while maintaining a straight back. (5) She stands up fully, smiles brightly at the camera with expressive eyes, and makes peace signs with both hands while doing a playful dance step.
